task: Find the maximum video recording resolution supported by the latest iPad mini on the Apple website.
answer: The latest iPad mini (A17 Pro chip) on the Apple website supports a maximum video recording resolution of 4K video recording at up to 60 fps (4K at 24, 25, 30, or 60 fps), as listed in the Video Recording section of the iPad mini Tech Specs page at https://www.apple.com/ipad-mini/specs/.
